summary.text: Unifying Human and Gu is the refinement path insight that using a human to refine Gu and using Gu to refine a human are two sides of one logic. Fang Yuan reaches it through Human Sea revival.

claims.text: After activating human revival sea with the completed Human Sea, Fang Yuan gains a crucial refinement path breakthrough: the Human Sea revival method is in essence refining the human body and soul with Gu, a human path method that also uses Gu to refine a human. Using a human to refine Gu and using Gu to refine a human are interchangeable in essence, like two sides of a coin, and the true core is Unifying Human and Gu. Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu turns into a human body after activation without providing a soul, creating a sovereign immortal body most compatible with the cultivator’s soul; Human Sea revival refines both human body and soul. Qing Chou was originally a killer move converted into a life form, which shows any life form can be created with a Gu cultivation method, as hinted when The Legends of Ren Zu states myriad lifeforms began as Gu within the Blue Sea of Life washed ashore into living forms. Human and Gu were one to begin with; that comprehension lets him design a killer move to unravel Ni clan methods and extract Immortal Gu from Ni clan bodies. He places this opposite hairy man nature refinement and Limitless refining heaven and earth with Gu, as the human isolation style’s counterpart to using Gu to refine human.
